# QCipher

> QCipher helps organisations prepare for post-quantum cryptography migration by discovering quantum-vulnerable cryptography, generating CBOMs, prioritizing risk, and supporting crypto-agility.

## Site

- Canonical site: https://qcipher.de/
- German version: https://qcipher.de/index_de.html
- Logo: https://qcipher.de/qcipher-logo.png
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/qcipher
- Contact and demo booking: https://outlook.office.com/book/QCipherteammeet@qcipher.de/?ismsaljsauthenabled

## What QCipher does

- Discovers cryptographic assets across code, dependencies, certificates, and infrastructure.
- Generates and ingests CycloneDX 1.7 CBOM reports.
- Scores findings by vulnerability, sensitivity, and exposure.
- Prioritizes post-quantum cryptography migration work.
- Supports crypto-agility planning so algorithms can be replaced repeatedly as standards and threats change.
- Keeps customer code and data inside the customer's environment.

## Primary topics

- Post-quantum cryptography
- PQC migration
- Crypto-agility
- Cryptographic asset discovery
- CBOM
- Quantum risk assessment
- HNDL-aware prioritization
- Local graph intelligence
